SIGN_IN.text: Patient has confirmed identity, site, procedure and consent
Anaesthesia machine and medication check complete
Pulse oximeter on patient and functioning
Risk of >500 ml blood loss (7 ml/kg in children)?

TIME_OUT.text: All team members have introduced themselves by name and role
Surgeon, anaesthetist and nurse verbally confirm patient, site and procedure
Surgeon: critical steps, operative duration, anticipated blood loss
Nursing: sterility confirmed, equipment issues or concerns
Antibiotic prophylaxis given within the last 60 minutes / not applicable

SIGN_OUT.text: Nurse verbally confirms the name of the procedure recorded
Instrument, sponge and needle counts are correct
Specimen labelled including patient name / not applicable
Any equipment problems to be addressed have been identified
Surgeon, anaesthetist and nurse review key concerns for recovery
